title: SEBI Tightens Margin Trading Facility (MTF) Rules: Net Worth Limit Raised to ₹5 Crore
summary: Raises broker net worth requirement from ₹3 crore to ₹5 crore and allows LLPs to offer MTFs.

blocks.content: Raises broker net worth requirement from ₹3 crore to ₹5 crore and allows LLPs to offer MTFs.

items: Net Worth Cap: Broker net worth requirement raised from ₹3 crore to ₹5 crore; LLPs permitted.
Locked Net Worth: Locked-away amount = lower of 2x min net worth or 50% total net worth.
Exposure Ceiling: Remaining net worth usable for MTF within overall exposure limit of 5.5x net worth (single client cap 10%).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: MTF allows investors to buy stocks by paying a margin while broker funds the rest.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Broker net worth cap (₹5 crore) vs MTF exposure limit (5.5x net worth).
